comment: Scanned PBR sources (CC0, Poly Haven), packed by tools/textures/build.mjs into data/textures/<id>.{alb,nrm,hgt}.webp. `size` is the packed albedo/normal resolution (height/AO is half). `layer` is the index in the runtime texture arrays (src/materials/library.js, MAT in shaders/materials.wgsl.js) — append only.

materials.use: Shaper ashlar — pale, weathered, chipped limestone faces
Shaper ashlar — smoother dressed faces, carved parts
outcrops and boulders — dark stratified rock
rubble and scree at feet of walls and rocks
weathered timber — sleds, poles, beams, staffs
felt and wool — tents, bundles, robe detail
